name: Bench2Drive-Full-Sup
description: Bench2Drive-Full-Sup is a supervised driving benchmark providing dense annotations for perception and driving-policy tasks (e.g., object detection, lane and semantic segmentation, trajectory labels and behavior cloning). It measures model performance on core autonomous-driving tasks across large-scale frame sequences under realistic driving conditions. The suite enables evaluation of both modular perception components and end-to-end supervised control approaches.
evaluation_method: mean_average_precision (mAP) for detection / IoU for segmentation / ADE/FDE for trajectories (primary reported detection metric: mAP)
reputation: Niche but useful dataset for supervised autonomous-driving research; less widely adopted than major commercial benchmarks (e.g., nuScenes) but used by focused academic groups.
